rappel_detail.anchor: an old bolt on top of the summit block; back it up
rappel_detail.station: The top of Chianti's summit block.
rappel_detail.notes: One short rappel, or a downclimb, off the summit block back onto the north face. Then reverse the line to the Burgundy-Chianti notch.

set.rappels: 1 short rappel or downclimb off the summit block, from an old bolt, then reverse the route to the Burgundy-Chianti notch; bring two ropes only if rappelling the east face instead
